about: Checks whose result can change between runs with timing alone. The study's tasks are frozen, so these are documented, not edited. A replay mismatch on one of these exact fields is reported but does not fail the replay check; any other mismatch does.

checks.reason: The audit test 'the sleep function is awaited before the next attempt' waits a fixed 20 ms for an attempt and a sleep call to happen; in the split-container gate both go through the cross-container proxy, which can take longer on a loaded machine. The committed run recorded the audit as passing; the CI replay of the same code on 2026-11-16 recorded it as failing.
